note: Gentle, slow movement for every age. Move within a comfortable range and breathe naturally. Stop if you feel pain, dizziness or breathlessness. If you are pregnant, recovering from surgery or have a heart, blood-pressure or other medical condition, check with your doctor first.

steps.name: 1. Holding up the sky
steps.text: Interlace the fingers and press the palms up, rising tall; lower slowly.

steps.name: 2. Drawing the bow
steps.text: In a horse stance, push one hand out and draw the other back like pulling a bow; change sides.

steps.name: 3. Separating heaven and earth
steps.text: Press one palm up and the other down; change hands.

steps.name: 4. Looking back
steps.text: Turn the head and shoulders to look behind; return and change sides.

steps.name: 5. Swaying head and tail
steps.text: In a horse stance, lean and circle the upper body side to side.

steps.name: 6. Touching the toes
steps.text: Slide the hands down the legs toward the feet, then rise slowly.

steps.name: 7. Punching with focus
steps.text: In a horse stance, punch slowly forward, alternating hands.

steps.name: 8. Bouncing on the toes
steps.text: Rise onto the toes, then drop gently onto the heels.

how: Eight slow movements, each repeated about 8 times.
Breathe naturally and keep the knees soft.

steps.name: 1. Tiger
steps.text: Raise clawed hands slowly overhead, then press down with strength.

steps.name: 2. Deer
steps.text: Turn the waist with hands raised like antlers, reaching behind.

steps.name: 3. Bear
steps.text: Sway heavily side to side, arms rounded, rotating from the waist.

steps.name: 4. Monkey
steps.text: Rise on the toes, hand at the brow as if looking out; light and alert.

steps.name: 5. Crane
steps.text: Stand on one leg with the arms spread like wings; change legs.

how: Imitate each animal's movement and spirit with slow, flowing breath.

steps.name: 1. Palms together at the chest
steps.text: Stand quietly, palms joined, shoulders relaxed.

steps.name: 2. Arms stretched to the sides
steps.text: Open the arms to shoulder height, palms down; hold and breathe.

steps.name: 3. Pressing up to the sky
steps.text: Rise on the toes and press both palms overhead.

steps.name: 4. Reaching up and back
steps.text: Reach one hand up and back, the other low behind; change sides.

steps.name: 5. Pulling back in a bow stance
steps.text: Step forward and draw the arms back slowly with strength.

steps.name: 6. Pushing the palms forward
steps.text: Push the palms forward slowly as if moving a heavy door.

steps.name: 7. Bowing forward
steps.text: Fold forward gently, hands toward the feet, then rise.

steps.name: 8. Swinging the arms
steps.text: Let the arms swing loosely while turning the waist.

how: Slow tendon-stretching movements held with steady breath.

steps.name: 1. Commencing
steps.text: Feet shoulder-width apart; float the arms up to shoulder height and lower them.

steps.name: 2. Parting the wild horse's mane
steps.text: Step into a bow stance and part the hands, one forward, one back.

steps.name: 3. White crane spreads its wings
steps.text: Weight back, one hand up, one down, front toe resting lightly.

steps.name: 4. Brush knee and push
steps.text: Brush one hand past the knee and push the other forward.

steps.name: 5. Wave hands like clouds
steps.text: Shift side to side with the hands circling before the body.

steps.name: 6. Closing
steps.text: Bring the hands down slowly and stand quietly.

how: Move continuously and slowly, weight shifting smoothly from leg to leg.

steps.name: 1. Wake early
steps.text: Rise before sunrise when you can; sit quietly for a moment.

steps.name: 2. Warm water
steps.text: Drink a glass of warm water.

steps.name: 3. Tongue scraping
steps.text: Scrape the tongue gently from back to front a few times.

steps.name: 4. Oil pulling
steps.text: Swish a spoon of sesame or coconut oil in the mouth, then spit it out (not in the sink).

steps.name: 5. Self-massage (abhyanga)
steps.text: Massage warm oil into the body with long strokes on limbs, circles on joints.

steps.name: 6. Movement
steps.text: A few rounds of sun salutation or a short walk.

steps.name: 7. Breathing and stillness
steps.text: Sit for a few minutes of calm breathing or meditation.

how: A gentle daily rhythm from Ayurveda; adapt the times to your day.
items.caution: Skip oil pulling if you might swallow the oil; skip abhyanga on broken skin.

steps.name: 1. Neck
steps.text: Nod slowly, turn side to side, then tilt ear to shoulder.

steps.name: 2. Shoulders
steps.text: Circle the shoulders forward, then back.

steps.name: 3. Elbows and wrists
steps.text: Bend and straighten the elbows; circle the wrists both ways.

steps.name: 4. Waist
steps.text: Hands on the hips, circle the waist slowly both ways.

steps.name: 5. Hips
steps.text: Stand on one leg with support and circle the other knee; change legs.

steps.name: 6. Knees
steps.text: Bend the knees slightly and circle them together.

steps.name: 7. Ankles
steps.text: Lift one foot and circle the ankle both ways; change feet.

how: Loosens each joint from the top down, about 10 slow circles each.
Breathe in for 4 counts and out for 4 counts through the nose.
Let the belly rise and fall; keep it easy.
